title: Large-Scale Wasserstein Gradient Flows
tldr_zh: Brenier 定理把 JKO 步改写为凸势优化，ICNN 参数化 + SGD 求解，免网格免粒子且可采样算密度
tldr_en: Rewrites each JKO step via Brenier as optimization over convex potentials parametrized by ICNNs and trained with SGD; grid-free, particle-free, with sampling and density evaluation.
key_numbers: Bayesian logistic regression vs SVGD, accuracy/test LL: covtype 0.75/-0.515 vs 0.75/-0.515; german 0.67/-0.60 vs 0.65/-0.60; waveform 0.78/-0.485 vs 0.765/-0.465 (Table 1)
Stationary Gaussian-mixture convergence D=2..12 with K=40 JKO steps, h=0.1: lower SymKL than EM particles 1K/10K/50K (Fig. 1, curves only)
OU process D=1..12 at t=0.5/0.9: lowest SymKL vs EM, EM PR, Dual JKO (Fig. 3, curves only)
Complexity: log det Hessian O(DT + D^3); sampling from rho^(k) O((k-1)T); training K steps ~ K^2 (Table 2, Sec. 5)
Wall-clock: minutes to hours on a GTX 1080Ti per experiment vs seconds-minutes CPU for particle methods; ~100-150 GPU hours total (Sec. 4-5)
